title: Levelplate
description: Adds plates above mobs indicating their level
body:
![Levelplate Neoforge Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/841b148659600674c6d8a65c5a9a0a3be2bfc446_0.webp) Adds plates above mobs indicating their level. Needs a mod that increments HP to the mobs like [Scaling Difficulty](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/scaling-difficulty) ![A level 3 Slime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf463e50a0b52d2e74ef0766ca11855339896417.png) This mod is a direct port from [Globox's Nameplate](https://modrinth.com/mod/nameplate) to the NeoForge. Requires [Cloth Config](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cloth-config) ## Highly configurable ![A lv 3 Camel with rose text and red HP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3dbe1c8354a967e3a1b0017ef1f7e38c6a3847ef.png)
1. You can change the color of the name with HEX format 2. You can enable a HP numeric or bar 3. Change the render distance of the levelplate 4. And more :D
Compatibility list 1. Cobblemon (Lv appears but no name until battling the cobblemon)
2. Jade (Lv.X appears on bottom box)
3. MCA (Requires change the mca.json and turn to false the variable showNameTags)
